QUOTE: `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque(x)` hides a value from the optimiser. In asm it is an empty `asm volatile ("" : "+r"(x))`. In C it is `x ^ mbedtls_ct_zero`
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque as the primitive hiding a value from the compiler and places the real API in library/constant_time_impl.h (and constant_time_internal.h), though it doesn't tie the primitive to that file in a single sentence.
